reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin whose primary user-facing purpose is interpreting uploaded, local, or URL-based images through configured vision models and presenting the results in chat, with GUI configuration and host integration.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 添加图片理解能力，可通过配置的视觉模型描述聊天中的本地图片、图片 URL，并支持后续细节解析。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding to DSH by using configured vision models to describe local images, image URLs, and follow-up visual details in chat.

capabilities: Reads local image files and accepts image URLs
Sends image data or URLs to configured vision model APIs
Automatically generates and refines image descriptions during chat
Stores configured model endpoints and credentials
Modifies host files through installation and patch scripts
